name: io.github.bnth09productions-maker/scrapling-x402-store-hardware
title: Scrapling Used GPU & RAM Sold Prices
description: Used GPU & DDR4/DDR5 RAM sold prices on eBay across 7 markets (US/EU/UK) via x402 USDC.

tools.name: list_hardware_datasets
tools.description: FREE. The 4 used GPU and RAM sold-price datasets for sale (live_gpu_ram_prices, gpu_ram_sold_7d, gpu_ram_sold_14d, gpu_ram_sold_30d): id, title, description, row count, field names, created_at (freshness), a few sample rows and the USDC price buy_dataset will charge. JSON output.

tools.name: preview_dataset
tools.description: Only the 4 GPU/RAM sold-price datasets on this server. FREE. Sample of a dataset before buying: up to 3 real rows from the dataset (never more than half of it), all field names, total row count, created_at timestamp and the exact USDC price buy_dataset will charge. JSON output. Returns JSON with up to 3 real rows (never more than half the dataset), every field name, the total row count, created_at, and the exact USDC price buy_dataset charges.

dataset_id.description: One of the 4 GPU/RAM datasets (see list_hardware_datasets).

tools.name: buy_dataset
tools.description: Only the 4 GPU/RAM sold-price datasets on this server. PAID, $0.01-$0.09 USDC (shown in list_datasets). Every row of a dataset in one download, e.g. dataset_id=live_crypto_top500_markets (~155 coins, Chainlink on-chain prices). Formats: json, jsonl, csv or markdown. Live feeds refresh about every 30 min. An unpaid call returns the exact x402 price. Returns every row of the dataset in the requested format (json, jsonl, csv, or markdown).

dataset_id.description: One of the 4 GPU/RAM datasets (see list_hardware_datasets).

format.description: File format of the download. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: csv. Default: json. Allowed values: json, jsonl, csv, markdown.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
